decision.observation: 13 mph, gear 1, timer 58:57.137 — back on the gravel and moving well. The car sits centre-road, nose up-frame slightly right; the road runs on up-frame between pines, poles and pink/teal banners, bending gently. Boulders on the right verge.
decision.hypothesis: The long W+A beat paid off: 3 -> 13 mph and the car landed on the road centre. A short plain-W beat should be safe while the road ahead is straight, before the next bend needs a correction.
decision.memory: A single 1.2 s W+A from 3 mph on grass gained 10 mph AND rejoined the gravel — long beats beat repeated short taps on this verge. Resetting the earlier 'short bursts only' rule for off-road recovery.
